projects.title: Educational Interactive Videoconferencing System
projects.description:
National Videoconference System is a tool to facilitate the
development of processes and SENA missionary activities of the
training: training of officials, trainers and trainees, technology
and knowledge transfer, and support for different projects
entity.
This project was conducted with LAMP technologies server side
and client side with Jquery performed.
In addition to a solution that was implemented with Wooza
Media Server to support the need for live video streaming.

projects.title: Agendamiento y Videostreaming
projects.description: Proyecto de agendamiento y visualización de videoconferencias en streaming en vivo y por demanda donde los usuarios pueden acceder a la página y ver la video conferencias que el SENA dispone semana a semana.
